lines.t: [Title: The Measuring Line]
I came to hear the thunder,
But the thunder searched my heart.
I came to name the darkness;
Let the searching in me start.
We read about the wilderness,
The manna and the sand,
How mercy fed a people
Who resisted every command.
But when correction finds my door,
Do I receive it as Your care?
Or point across the table,
Like the fault is always there?
I cannot call it wisdom
If it never changes me.
I cannot praise the light
And hide what it reveals in me.
Let conviction find repentance;
Let repentance bear its fruit.
Let the words I love to trumpet
Take a deeper, living root.
Set my heart against the measuring line;
I will not bend the truth to make it mine.
YahuShua, teach these feet to follow You,
Till the love upon my lips is what I do.
Not a louder claim, not a higher place—
Let my life bear witness to Your grace.
When the word is hard, let my answer be:
Lord, begin the work in me.
The word I thought was for another
Found the chamber of my pride.
I knew the language of surrender;
Still had places left to hide.
There is no crown in knowing
What I will not choose to live.
There is no love in asking mercy
While refusing to forgive.
If I have heard more clearly,
Let me answer with more care.
Not stand above my brother,
But help the weight he has to bear.
Let conviction find repentance;
Let repentance bear its fruit.
Let the words I love to trumpet
Take a deeper, living root.
Set my heart against the measuring line;
I will not bend the truth to make it mine.
YahuShua, teach these feet to follow You,
Till the love upon my lips is what I do.
Not a louder claim, not a higher place—
Let my life bear witness to Your grace.
When the word is hard, let my answer be:
Lord, begin the work in me.
Put away the old man's clothing,
All the bitterness and lies.
Let the mind be made anew;
Let the hidden things come to light.
Not a moment's swell of feeling,
Not a promise made in tears—
But a faithful, daily walking
When no watching crowd is near.
Let me do what's just before You,
Let me love the mercy shown,
Let me walk in humble service,
Not make righteousness my throne.
I have used another's failure
To avoid confessing mine.
I have asked for understanding
While resisting what I find.
No more shelter in comparison,
No more bargaining with light.
Let me turn from what I know is wrong
And choose what I know is right.
Hearing into doing,
Knowing into love,
Mercy for my brother,
Eyes on things above.
Faithful in the quiet,
Honest in the trial—
Not merely words of sorrow,
But a changed and willing life.
Set our hearts against the measuring line;
We will not bend the truth to make it ours.
YahuShua, teach these feet to follow You,
Till the love upon our lips is what we do.
Not a louder claim, not a higher place—
Let our lives bear witness to Your grace.
When the word is hard, let our answer be:
Lord, begin the work in me.
When I rise, and when I lie down,
When there's no one else to see,
Let my walk agree with my confession.
Lord, begin the work in me.
